proposedArchitecture: Require cause, domain, exact size, owner and lifecycle at allocation and transport boundaries. Preserve ordinary range/bounds errors as such; record failures and state transitions without per-pixel logging.

For every phase declare its minimum useful working set, simultaneous live buffers and next publication boundary. Admit parallel units dynamically with this envelope; optional caches use remaining capacity.

Materialize actual reusable completion buffers as part of useful preparation, so a late small allocation cannot discard already-completed expensive work. Prefer same-slot reuse over retire/reallocate.

Keep authoritative ELA cell and per-quality Ghost checkpoints separately from disposable acceleration caches. Publication must await storage acknowledgement and update a compact bitmap. Preserve numeric order; no resolution/parameter reduction.
Offer resident and paged paths for Ghost data. Aggregation can use extrema6000000 + one plane3000000 + integral3010008 + curves8520000bytes rather than requiring a resident213MBcube.
Checkpoint D2 postprocessed masks and projection zone/plane/band; retry only the uncommitted band while retaining raw inference.

Reclaim optional cache in relevant increments with acknowledgement; restore useful acceleration when the failed request is satisfied rather than keeping a global freeze across an entire provider lifetime.

Validate end-to-end allocation failures through real worker boundaries and scientific output parity, then use a cold96MP result as the full-run qualification. Keep aggressive parallelism; no permanent arbitrary global CPU/RAM reduction.

Expose terminal-preparation-error/draining as soon as decided, including original cause, active fields retained, completed checkpoints and missing work. Do not report a generic running state as overall healthy advancement.
